It would allow assisted dying for French adults with a "serious and incurable" life-threatening illness "in an advanced or terminal stage". The illness would need to leave them in constant physical or psychological suffering that is unbearable or resistant to treatment. The patient would need to "freely manifest his or her intention" to a doctor, who would then make a decision after consultation within 15 days. After two days of reflection, the patient would have to administer a lethal substance themselves. If they were unable to do so, it could be done by a doctor or nurse. The patient's decision to go ahead with the procedure would have to be verified by the physician on the day.
